about: Mock Forge seed for tools/mock-forge-mcp.mjs --seed: the tickets, Confluence pages and goals a connected scan of the Pebble Shop fixture sees, in the item shapes of docs/contracts/forge-mcp-2.md.

tickets.title: Export my order history to a spreadsheet
tickets.body: I run a small cafe and buy from Pebble every month. My accountant wants all orders as CSV or Excel. Today I copy each order by hand. Please add an export.

tickets.title: CSV download of orders for bookkeeping
tickets.body: Is there a way to download my orders as CSV? I need them for my tax return. Support told me to ask here.

tickets.title: Please add export of orders (csv)
tickets.body: We order for our office. Finance needs a list of all orders with totals each quarter. An export button on the orders page would save me an hour.

tickets.title: Export orders again
tickets.body: Same customer as SHOP-101: following up, my accountant still needs the CSV export of orders.

tickets.title: Filter my orders by status
tickets.body: My order history has 80 orders. I only want to see the ones that are not shipped yet. A status filter (paid / shipped / delivered) would help.

tickets.title: Show only refunded orders
tickets.body: I want to check which orders were refunded. The order list shows everything mixed; please let me filter by refunded.

tickets.title: Order history: pending orders only
tickets.body: Can the orders page filter on status? I keep scrolling to find what is still in transit.

tickets.title: Receipt e-mail never arrived - please resend
tickets.body: Order #1042. I did not get the receipt e-mail and need it for my expenses. Could you send it again? I wish I could do this myself.

tickets.title: Resend receipt for order 1077
tickets.body: The receipt went to my old e-mail address. Please resend the receipt. Is there a button somewhere to do it myself?

tickets.title: No receipt e-mail
tickets.body: Third time I write to support to get a receipt resent. Please let customers resend receipts from the order page.

tickets.title: Card declined and the whole form was empty again
tickets.body: My card was declined at checkout. The page said 'Something went wrong. Please try again later.' and everything I had typed was gone. I gave up and ordered elsewhere.

tickets.title: Payment error message is useless
tickets.body: Payment failed with 'Something went wrong'. Was it my card? The expiry date? I had to retype my card three times to find out it was the CVC.

tickets.title: Cancelling Pebble Box takes forever
tickets.body: Signing up was one click. Cancelling was a survey, a discount, a countdown and a 'pause' box that was already ticked - I almost paused instead of cancelling.

tickets.title: Could not cancel my box, it got paused
tickets.body: I clicked through the cancel pages and ended up with a paused subscription, not a cancelled one. The pause option was pre-selected.

tickets.title: Screen reader cannot use checkout
tickets.body: I use NVDA. On the checkout page the card fields have no labels, the card logos are read as file names, and the pay button is not announced at all. I cannot pay without help.

tickets.title: Pay button not reachable with keyboard
tickets.body: Tabbing through checkout skips the pay button entirely. I have to use the mouse, which is hard for me.

tickets.title: Did my address save?
tickets.body: When I click Save address at checkout nothing happens on screen. I clicked it five times. Did it save?

tickets.title: Save address gives no confirmation
tickets.body: No message after saving the delivery address. I was not sure, so I typed it again in the payment step notes.

tickets.title: How do I turn on guest checkout?
tickets.body: The release notes mention guest checkout, but the configuration guide does not say how to enable it. Which setting is it?

tickets.title: pebble orders sync: unknown command
tickets.body: Our nightly cron runs `npx pebble orders sync` as the CLI guide says. Since we upgraded it prints the usage text and exits 2.

tickets.title: Cart rejects my 25th item
tickets.body: The docs say a cart can hold 50 items, but adding the 21st item says the cart is full at 20.

tickets.title: Dark mode please
tickets.body: Would be great to have a dark theme for the shop.

pages.title: Pebble Shop operations runbook
pages.body: Nightly jobs: at 02:00 cron runs `npx pebble orders sync` to push orders to accounting, then `npx pebble report nightly --out /srv/reports`. If sync fails, re-run it by hand.

pages.title: Checkout settings for shop owners
pages.body: Sessions end after 30 minutes without activity (SESSION_TTL_MINUTES). Prices are charged in EUR unless CURRENCY is set.

goals.title: Self-serve order management
goals.body: Customers answer their own order questions - status, receipts, records for bookkeeping - without writing to support. Target: support tickets about orders down 40% by Q2 2027.

goals.title: Cut checkout abandonment
goals.body: Fewer shoppers give up between cart and paid order. Target: abandonment from 38% to 30% by Q1 2027.
